correctness.rationale: For the repaired claim, conditioning on the tree and marks through vertex j gives E[C_n|F_j]=M_n(p)C_j/M_j(p). The root-attachment indicator I_j is independent of earlier history, and E[I_j X_j]=p/(j-1). The local covariance splits into M_n times a telescoping reciprocal-product difference minus p/((j-1)(j-1+p)); summing proves the finite input identity, including p=0 and p=1. For lambda=(1-p)log n bounded, expansion of the log product has a uniform error bounded by a constant times (1-p)^2 times the convergent inverse-square sum, and the controlled tails of T_n(p) yield uniform convergence to zeta(2)-1. The global bound e^(-lambda(H_n-1)/log n)(log n/n+lambda) excludes both 0 and infinity as limits of rescaled maximizers, which exist by continuity. Compact-window convergence and the unique maximum of lambda exp(-lambda) then identify every maximizing sequence and the peak. In the frozen original the weighted subset lemma correctly uses log-concavity of elementary symmetric functions and conditions separately on the last-item indicator, allowing a nested full-vector coupling with shared alternative parents and marks. Its strict tail is also exactly 1-(1-p)^d. The rising factorial identity for the root cluster gives 2M_n(2p)-M_n(p)-M_n(p)^2 for variance, with positive leading coefficient for fixed p<1 by strict digamma increase, verifying the original decorrelation calculation.
